lines.zh: 贴着树干侧面往上挪，慢得看不见。
lines.en: It creeps up the trunk's side, too slow to see moving.

lines.zh: 身后留下一条亮亮的黏液带。
lines.en: A bright trail of slime is left behind it.

lines.zh: 爬过苔藓时，把苔藓压出浅窝。
lines.en: Crossing the moss, it presses shallow dents into it.

lines.zh: 一根触角先探出去，身体才跟上。
lines.en: One tentacle reaches out before the body follows.

lines.zh: 从蘑菇伞下滑过，伞面晃了晃。
lines.en: It slides under a mushroom cap and the cap sways.

lines.zh: 一整分钟才挪过一片叶子。
lines.en: A whole minute to get across a single leaf.

lines.zh: 越过小石子，身体被拉得细长。
lines.en: Crossing a pebble, its body stretches long and thin.

lines.zh: 它顺着倒木的沟槽走，省力些。
lines.en: It follows the groove of a fallen log to save effort.

lines.zh: 黏液把枯叶粘在身后，拖着走。
lines.en: Slime glues a dead leaf behind it and it drags along.

lines.zh: 遇到干土就掉头，宁可绕远。
lines.en: Meeting dry soil, it turns back and takes the long way.

lines.zh: 爬过菌丝层时，身体亮得像蜡。
lines.en: Over the mycelium it looks glossy as wax.

lines.zh: 它在树皮缝里拐了个弯，不慌不忙。
lines.en: It rounds a crack in the bark without any hurry.

lines.zh: 慢吞吞地蠕动着
lines.en: Slowly slithering along

lines.zh: 黏糊糊的身子蠕动
lines.en: Slimy body moving

lines.zh: 在地上留下了黏液
lines.en: Leaving slime trail behind

lines.zh: 粘在地面上滑行
lines.en: Sliding along the ground

lines.zh: 粘在方块上缓缓移动
lines.en: Moving slowly on blocks

lines.zh: 尾巴拖出黏液
lines.en: Tail trailing slime

lines.zh: 粘在石头上慢慢爬
lines.en: Crawling slowly on stone

lines.zh: 粘着树叶爬行
lines.en: Crawling on leaves

lines.zh: 粘附在树干上
lines.en: Attached to a tree

lines.zh: 粘在石头上蠕动
lines.en: Slithering on stone

lines.zh: 黄澄澄的身子在林下挪。
lines.en: Its yellow body inches along the forest floor.

lines.zh: 爬过一片就留下一道亮痕。
lines.en: It leaves a bright trail wherever it passes.

lines.zh: 黏液垫在身下，慢慢推。
lines.en: It pushes itself over a cushion of slime.

lines.zh: 倒挂在叶子背面往前蹭。
lines.en: It creeps along the underside of a leaf.

lines.zh: 触角一伸一缩地探路。
lines.en: Its tentacles stretch and shrink as it probes ahead.

lines.zh: 爬过苔藓，黏出一条线。
lines.en: It crosses the moss, drawing a sticky line.

lines.zh: 趴在蘑菇伞下面，一动不动。
lines.en: It rests beneath a mushroom cap without stirring.

lines.zh: 触角缩回去，只剩一根短的露着。
lines.en: Its tentacles retract until only a stub shows.

lines.zh: 身体背面铺着黑斑，像香蕉皮。
lines.en: Black spots pattern its back like a banana peel.

lines.zh: 呼吸孔一开一合，很慢。
lines.en: The breathing pore opens and closes, very slowly.

lines.zh: 它把自己摊平，像一小块湿面团。
lines.en: It flattens out like a lump of wet dough.

lines.zh: 挂在方块侧面，黏液让它没掉下去。
lines.en: It clings to the block's side, slime holding it up.

lines.zh: 一只小虫爬过它背上，它也不动。
lines.en: A small bug crosses its back and it does not react.

lines.zh: 树冠滴水，它就着水珠洗了洗触角。
lines.en: Water drips from the canopy and it washes its tentacles.

lines.zh: 身体一伸一缩，像在打瞌睡。
lines.en: It stretches and contracts as if dozing.

lines.zh: 藏在烂木缝里，只露出一点黄。
lines.en: It hides in a rotten wood seam with just a bit of yellow showing.

lines.zh: 黏液在它周围聚成一小圈亮边。
lines.en: Slime gathers in a bright ring around it.

lines.zh: 它在等菌丝长得再密一些。
lines.en: It is waiting for the mycelium to grow a little denser.

lines.zh: 触角顶端动了动，闻到了什么。
lines.en: The tips of its tentacles stir at some scent.

lines.zh: 苔藓比它软，它躺得很舒服。
lines.en: The moss is softer than it is and it lies comfortably.

lines.zh: 蘑菇伞下有一缕潮气。
lines.en: A thread of damp air under the mushroom cap.

lines.zh: 我把身子挪了半寸，就累了。
lines.en: I shift half an inch and I am tired.

lines.zh: 一滴露落在背上，滑了下去。
lines.en: A drop of dew lands on my back and slides off.

lines.zh: 树影挪了，我还在原来的位置。
lines.en: The tree's shadow moved; I did not.

lines.zh: 懒洋洋地趴着
lines.en: Lazily lying down

lines.zh: 粘在地面上不动
lines.en: Sticking to the ground

lines.zh: 粘在叶子上发呆
lines.en: Sticking to leaves

lines.zh: 粘在木头上歇息
lines.en: Resting on wood

lines.zh: 粘着树干发呆
lines.en: Sticking to a tree trunk

lines.zh: 粘在石头上打盹
lines.en: Dozing on stone

lines.zh: 粘着泥土发呆
lines.en: Sticking to dirt

lines.zh: 粘在树叶上休息
lines.en: Resting on leaves

lines.zh: 粘在方块上不动
lines.en: Sticking to a block

lines.zh: 粘着沙子发呆
lines.en: Sticking to sand

lines.zh: 缩成一小团黏在墙上。
lines.en: It curls into a small lump stuck to the wall.

lines.zh: 触角缩了回去，慢慢想。
lines.en: Its tentacles retract while it thinks slowly.

lines.zh: 两根触角一起抬起来对你。
lines.en: Both tentacles lift toward you at once.

lines.zh: 触角顶端那两点黑，一直对着你。
lines.en: The two dark tips of its tentacles stay fixed on you.

lines.zh: 它抬起身子，像在闻你鞋底。
lines.en: It raises its front end as if sniffing your boot sole.

lines.zh: 看了你很久，才慢慢缩回去。
lines.en: It watches you a long time before slowly withdrawing.

lines.zh: 眼睛长在触角上，只能朝这边看。
lines.en: Its eyes ride on its tentacles and can only look this way.

lines.zh: 你蹲下时，它把头抬得更高了。
lines.en: When you crouch, it lifts its head even higher.

lines.zh: 它对你的影子比对你有兴趣。
lines.en: It is more interested in your shadow than in you.

lines.zh: 触角碰了碰你的手指，凉的。
lines.en: A tentacle touches your finger and comes away cold.

lines.zh: 它慢慢转身，黏液在叶上打滑。
lines.en: It turns slowly and its slime slips on the leaf.

lines.zh: 你看它，它好像也在看你。
lines.en: You look at it and it seems to look back.

lines.zh: 它缩成一团，觉得没危险又摊开了。
lines.en: It balls up, decides there is no danger, and spreads out.

lines.zh: 那双柄眼一上一下，看得人发毛。
lines.en: Those stalked eyes seesaw and set your nerves on edge.

lines.zh: 香蕉色的身体停了一下。
lines.en: My banana-yellow body pauses.

lines.zh: 黏液在方块侧面拖出一道亮痕。
lines.en: Slime leaves a bright streak down the block.

lines.zh: 我抬起黏液里的两根触角。
lines.en: I lift my two tentacles out of the slime.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方亮了一条。
lines.en: I left a bright trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我没有壳，只能慢慢缩回去。
lines.en: Shell-less, I can only shrink slowly.

lines.zh: 看着玩家
lines.en: Looking at the player

lines.zh: 向玩家方向移动
lines.en: Moving towards the player

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方全是黏液。
lines.en: Everywhere I crawl is left slimy.

lines.zh: 你鞋底离我太近了。
lines.en: Your sole is far too close to me.

lines.zh: 它抬头，触角朝你转了转。
lines.en: It lifts its head, tentacles turning toward you.

lines.zh: 它缩成一个球，黏液挤出来一圈。
lines.en: It balls up and squeezes out a ring of slime.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，它掉了半截身子那么长。
lines.en: Struck, it shrinks by half a body length.

lines.zh: 它慌忙往木缝里钻，钻不进去。
lines.en: It scrambles for the wood crack and does not fit.

lines.zh: 触角全缩回去了，只剩光滑的背。
lines.en: The tentacles vanish, leaving only a smooth back.

lines.zh: 它抖了抖，把土粒抖掉。
lines.en: It shivers and shakes the grains of soil off.

lines.zh: 受伤的地方渗出更多黏液。
lines.en: The hurt place leaks more slime.

lines.zh: 它爬得比平时快了一点点。
lines.en: It crawls a tiny bit faster than usual.

lines.zh: 那一声几乎没有，只有黏液在响。
lines.en: The cry is almost nothing, only the slime making sound.

lines.zh: 它把自己压得更扁，贴住地面。
lines.en: It flattens itself even lower against the ground.

lines.zh: 它慢慢挪向阴影里，想躲起来。
lines.en: It creeps toward the shade, meaning to hide.

lines.zh: 软软的身体受伤了。
lines.en: My soft body is hurt.

lines.zh: 黏糊糊的我受伤了。
lines.en: My gooey self is hurt.

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓被撞伤了。
lines.en: Banana Slug was hit.

lines.zh: 我的黏液溅到了伤口。
lines.en: My slime splashed on the wound.

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓受了点小伤。
lines.en: Banana Slug got a small injury.

lines.zh: 身体被压扁了一块，很慢才鼓回来。
lines.en: Part of me is squashed flat and slowly refills.

lines.zh: 我被绊倒了。
lines.en: I tripped.

lines.zh: 黏液被割破了。
lines.en: My slime is cut.

lines.zh: 我的黏液流了一地。
lines.en: My slime is running all over the ground.

lines.zh: 身体被压得很扁。
lines.en: My body has been squashed very flat.

lines.zh: 闻到蘑菇味，触角全竖起来。
lines.en: Smelling mushroom, all its tentacles stand up.

lines.zh: 一小块真菌让它挪了半尺。
lines.en: A scrap of fungus moves it half a foot.

lines.zh: 它朝着菌盖爬，慢但不改方向。
lines.en: It creeps toward the mushroom cap, slow but unwavering.

lines.zh: 你把蘑菇放在叶上，它正对着过来。
lines.en: Set the mushroom on a leaf and it comes straight at it.

lines.zh: 它先舔了舔，才决定吃。
lines.en: It tastes first, then decides to eat.

lines.zh: 为了一口菌丝，它肯爬过整根木桩。
lines.en: For a mouthful of mycelium it will cross a whole stump.

lines.zh: 触角碰到食物，身体马上鼓起来。
lines.en: A tentacle finds the food and its body swells at once.

lines.zh: 它在你手边打转，黏液蹭了你一手。
lines.en: It circles your hand and leaves slime all over it.

lines.zh: 那点腐木的味道把它从缝里引出来。
lines.en: The smell of rotting wood draws it out of the crack.

lines.zh: 吃饱后它就伏在食物旁边不动了。
lines.en: Once fed, it simply lies down beside the food.

lines.zh: 我闻到了香蕉的香味！
lines.en: I smell banana!

lines.zh: 快给我香蕉吧！
lines.en: Give me banana!

lines.zh: 我爱香蕉！
lines.en: I love banana!

lines.zh: 请给我点香蕉！
lines.en: Give me some banana!

lines.zh: 香蕉是我的最爱！
lines.en: Banana is my favorite!

lines.zh: 求求你，给我香蕉！
lines.en: Please, give me banana!

lines.zh: 香蕉就是我的动力！
lines.en: Banana is my fuel!

lines.zh: 快点给我香蕉！
lines.en: Give me banana now!

lines.zh: 我需要吃香蕉！
lines.en: I need banana!

lines.zh: 没有香蕉我活不下去！
lines.en: No banana, no life!

lines.zh: 你碰到它，它软得几乎没有阻力。
lines.en: Touching it meets almost no resistance at all.

lines.zh: 它被挤得变形，然后又圆回来。
lines.en: It squashes out of shape, then rounds back.

lines.zh: 一整条黏液蹭到你裤腿上。
lines.en: A whole streak of slime transfers to your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 它慢慢爬上你的靴子，没打算下来。
lines.en: It climbs your boot slowly with no plan to get off.

lines.zh: 你踩下去收住了脚，它还在原地。
lines.en: You check your step and it is still right there.

lines.zh: 碰一下，它缩成小球滚了半圈。
lines.en: One touch and it balls up and rolls half a turn.

lines.zh: 它贴在你脚边，像块掉落的果皮。
lines.en: It clings by your foot like a dropped piece of peel.

lines.zh: 它被推开了，又慢慢挪回原位。
lines.en: Pushed aside, it creeps slowly back to the same spot.

lines.zh: 鞋底粘上它的黏液，走一步响一下。
lines.en: Its slime sticks to your sole and clicks with each step.

lines.zh: 它从你手背爬过，留下一道凉。
lines.en: It crawls across your hand and leaves a cool line.

lines.zh: 啊，撞到你了！
lines.en: Ouch, hit you!

lines.zh: 碰到了你！
lines.en: Hit you!

lines.zh: 我的黏液沾了你一鞋底。
lines.en: My slime smears across your sole.

lines.zh: 黏糊糊地贴上你的靴子。
lines.en: I stick to your boot, all slime.

lines.zh: 碰了你一下！
lines.en: Touched you!

lines.zh: 我身上黏糊糊的，别怪我。
lines.en: I'm covered in slime — don't blame me.

lines.zh: 撞上你了，真倒霉！
lines.en: Hit you, unlucky!

lines.zh: 不小心碰到了你！
lines.en: Accidentally hit you!

lines.zh: 撞上你了，真疼！
lines.en: Hit you, really hurts!

lines.zh: 撞到你了，真意外！
lines.en: Hit you, surprised!

lines.zh: 你鞋底粘上了我。
lines.en: I am stuck to the sole of your boot.

lines.zh: 别踩，我黏在石头上！
lines.en: Do not step! I am stuck to the stone!

lines.zh: 这一碰把我挤扁了。
lines.en: That bump squashed me flat.

lines.zh: 我黏在你的鞋帮上了。
lines.en: I am stuck to the side of your boot.

lines.zh: 两条蛞蝓首尾相绕，转成一个小圈。
lines.en: Two slugs coil head to tail into a small ring.

lines.zh: 它们用触角互相碰了很久。
lines.en: They touch tentacles back and forth for a long while.

lines.zh: 一对香蕉蛞蝓并排爬同一根木。
lines.en: A pair crawls side by side along the same log.

lines.zh: 黏液把它们粘住，分开要费点劲。
lines.en: Slime glues them together and parting takes some effort.

lines.zh: 它们慢慢绕着蘑菇转，像在跳舞。
lines.en: They circle the mushroom slowly, almost dancing.

lines.zh: 一条抬起前身，另一条跟着抬。
lines.en: One lifts its front half and the other follows.

lines.zh: 它们交换了位置，又换回来。
lines.en: They trade places, then trade back.

lines.zh: 两只一起缩进同一道树皮缝里。
lines.en: Both retreat into the same crack in the bark.

lines.zh: 触角缠了一下，算是打了招呼。
lines.en: The tentacles twine once, which counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 它们把卵藏在腐木下，动作很轻。
lines.en: They tuck their eggs under the rotten wood, gently.

lines.zh: 找个伴儿吧！
lines.en: Find a mate!

lines.zh: 找个伙伴！
lines.en: Find a partner!

lines.zh: 我要找伴儿！
lines.en: I need a mate!

lines.zh: 一起繁殖吧！
lines.en: Reproduce together!

lines.zh: 找一个伴儿！
lines.en: Find a buddy!

lines.zh: 找伴儿啊！
lines.en: Find a mate!

lines.zh: 我的黏液，能粘住一整块。
lines.en: My slime can glue a whole block.

lines.zh: 找个伴儿生宝宝！
lines.en: Find a mate to reproduce!

lines.zh: 找一个伴儿吧！
lines.en: Find a partner!

lines.zh: 两只蛞蝓贴着黏液缠在一起。
lines.en: Two slugs twine together in a shared trail.

lines.zh: 托在手里像一块凉凉的软糖。
lines.en: In your palm it feels like a cool soft candy.

lines.zh: 它从指缝里滑出去，又爬回来。
lines.en: It slips between your fingers, then crawls back.

lines.zh: 黏液拉着丝，从你的手垂到地上。
lines.en: Slime draws a thread from your hand to the ground.

lines.zh: 你抬起手，它就挂在你指尖上。
lines.en: You lift your hand and it hangs from your fingertips.

lines.zh: 它在掌心里摊平，看着更大了。
lines.en: It spreads flat in your palm and looks bigger.

lines.zh: 抓它得用叶子垫着，不然黏手。
lines.en: You need a leaf to hold it or your hand gets sticky.

lines.zh: 它慢慢爬上你的手腕，没有挣扎。
lines.en: It climbs your wrist slowly, without struggling.

lines.zh: 放回地面时，它先缩一下再伸展。
lines.en: Set down, it contracts once before stretching out.

lines.zh: 它在手心里留下一个亮亮的圆印。
lines.en: It leaves a bright round print in your palm.

lines.zh: 那么轻，你差点以为抓了个空。
lines.en: So light you almost think you grabbed nothing.

lines.zh: 黏液拖尾真漂亮！
lines.en: The trailing slime is so pretty!

lines.zh: 黏液块等你来采！
lines.en: Slime block waiting for you!

lines.zh: 黏液滴落，小心脚下！
lines.en: Slime drips, be careful where you step!

lines.zh: 黏液粘附，小心别滑倒！
lines.en: Watch out for slime, it's sticky!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓黏液，美味又黏手！
lines.en: Banana Slug slime, tasty and sticky!

lines.zh: 黏液滴答，香蕉蛞蝓黏了！
lines.en: Slime dripping, Banana Slug stuck!

lines.zh: 黏液拖行，香蕉蛞蝓慢悠悠！
lines.en: Trailing slime, Banana Slug moves slow!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓黏液，快采起来！
lines.en: Banana Slug slime, collect it!

lines.zh: 小心香蕉蛞蝓黏液黏住你！
lines.en: Be careful, Banana Slug slime!

lines.zh: 黏液黏手，快来拿取吧！
lines.en: Slime on, grab it!

lines.zh: 触角定向那丛真菌，身体跟着转。
lines.en: Its tentacles aim at the fungus patch and the body follows.

lines.zh: 它锁定了一朵小蘑菇，开始出发。
lines.en: It locks onto a small mushroom and sets off.

lines.zh: 有东西挡路，它只当是绕个弯。
lines.en: Something blocks the way; it treats it as a detour.

lines.zh: 它把嘴对准菌褶，慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: It aims its mouth at the gills and closes in slowly.

lines.zh: 目标很近，它也要爬上一刻钟。
lines.en: The target is close and it still takes a quarter hour.

lines.zh: 嗅到腐木的甜味，它换了方向。
lines.en: Catching the sweetness of rotten wood, it changes course.

lines.zh: 它认准了那片苔，别处都不去。
lines.en: It settles on that patch of moss and ignores everywhere else.

lines.zh: 身体前段抬起来，像在瞄准。
lines.en: Its front half lifts, as if taking aim.

lines.zh: 它选定目标后，连头都不再偏。
lines.en: Once the target is chosen it does not turn aside again.

lines.zh: 触角缩回，说明它已经决定好了。
lines.en: The tentacles pull in, which means the decision is made.

lines.zh: 找到了，香蕉蛞蝓！
lines.en: Found you, Banana Slug!

lines.zh: 黏液目标已锁定！
lines.en: Slime target locked!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓，我要抓住你！
lines.en: Banana Slug, I got you!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓在移动！
lines.en: Banana Slug moving!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓黏附目标！
lines.en: Banana Slug attached!

lines.zh: 追踪香蕉蛞蝓！
lines.en: Tracking Banana Slug!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓目标确定！
lines.en: Banana Slug target acquired!

lines.zh: 锁定香蕉蛞蝓黏液！
lines.en: Slime target acquired!

lines.zh: 找到了香蕉蛞蝓的行踪！
lines.en: Found Banana Slug's trail!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓被锁定，别想逃！
lines.en: Banana Slug locked, no escape!

lines.zh: 它一寸一寸靠近那朵蘑菇。
lines.en: It approaches the mushroom an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 黏液在身后连成一条直线。
lines.en: Its slime lays a straight line behind it.

lines.zh: 触角先碰到菌盖边缘，停住了。
lines.en: A tentacle meets the mushroom rim and stops.

lines.zh: 它不急，反正蘑菇不会跑。
lines.en: It is in no hurry; mushrooms do not run.

lines.zh: 身体一伸一缩，像在量还剩多远。
lines.en: It stretches and contracts, measuring the distance left.

lines.zh: 它绕开一片干叶，路线没变。
lines.en: It goes around a dry leaf without changing course.

lines.zh: 黏液标出了路，它沿着自己走。
lines.en: The slime marks the way and it follows its own trail.

lines.zh: 触角左右扫动，反复确认菌丛的位置。
lines.en: Its tentacles sweep side to side, confirming the fungus patch.

lines.zh: 它靠近到能闻见菌丝，才停下来。
lines.en: It stops only when close enough to smell the mycelium.

lines.zh: 它把前半身抬高，够向菌盖。
lines.en: It lifts its front half to reach the cap.

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓，别跑！
lines.en: Banana Slug, don't run!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓目标明确！
lines.en: Banana Slug target clear!

lines.zh: 锁定香蕉蛞蝓，别想逃脱！
lines.en: Targeting Banana Slug, can't escape!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓黏液要喷了！
lines.en: Banana Slug slime blast!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓黏液准备发射！
lines.en: Banana Slug slime ready!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓锁定目标，黏液射来！
lines.en: Banana Slug targeting, slime incoming!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓黏液瞄准射击！
lines.en: Banana Slug aiming slime!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓黏液即将发射！
lines.en: Banana Slug slime on standby!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓锁定并准备攻击！
lines.en: Banana Slug targeting and ready to attack!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓黏液瞄准锁定了！
lines.en: Banana Slug slime targeting!

lines.zh: 它整个身体撞过来，只是软软一顶。
lines.en: Its whole body bumps you, soft and harmless.

lines.zh: 说是攻击，其实只是爬到你鞋上。
lines.en: The attack amounts to crawling onto your shoe.

lines.zh: 它拿触角戳了你一下，就这些。
lines.en: It pokes you with a tentacle, and that is all.

lines.zh: 那一撞把黏液抹了你一腿。
lines.en: The bump smears slime down your leg.

lines.zh: 它没有牙，只能用身体压过来。
lines.en: It has no teeth, so it just leans its weight on you.

lines.zh: 它试图缠住你的手指，滑掉了。
lines.en: It tries to wrap your finger and slides off.

lines.zh: 这一下唯一的伤害是黏。
lines.en: The only damage here is the stickiness.

lines.zh: 它撞完自己也晃了晃，慢慢稳住。
lines.en: After the bump it sways, then slowly steadies.

lines.zh: 它的攻击像一块湿布拍在脚背上。
lines.en: Its attack is like a wet cloth slapped on your instep.

lines.zh: 它甚至没意识到自己撞到了什么。
lines.en: It never even realizes what it ran into.

lines.zh: 黏液糊满脸
lines.en: Gloop in face!

lines.zh: 黏糊糊袭击
lines.en: Goo attack!

lines.zh: 滚过去咬你
lines.en: Roll and bite!

lines.zh: 黏液触手攻击
lines.en: Goo tentacle attack!

lines.zh: 黏糊糊的触碰
lines.en: Goo touch!

lines.zh: 被黏液包围
lines.en: Surrounded by goo!

lines.zh: 黏液溅你一身
lines.en: Goo splat!

lines.zh: 黏糊糊的反击
lines.en: Goo retaliation!

lines.zh: 黏液喷射
lines.en: Goo spray!

lines.zh: 黏糊糊的攻击
lines.en: Goo attack!

lines.zh: 腐木下面翻出一条亮黄色的蛞蝓。
lines.en: A bright yellow slug turns up under the rotten log.

lines.zh: 老林深处，苔上多了一点黄。
lines.en: Deep in the old forest, a spot of yellow appears on the moss.

lines.zh: 它从菌丝里钻出来，身上还沾着白丝。
lines.en: It emerges from the mycelium with white threads on its back.

lines.zh: 树皮缝里挤出一段柔软的身子。
lines.en: A soft length of body squeezes out of a bark crack.

lines.zh: 露水还没干，它已经开始爬了。
lines.en: The dew is still wet and it is already crawling.

lines.zh: 一片香蕉色的影子贴在树干上。
lines.en: A banana-colored shape clings to the trunk.

lines.zh: 它的黏液在石头上留下第一道亮痕。
lines.en: Its slime leaves the first bright streak on the stone.

lines.zh: 苔藓层动了一下，是它在下面翻身。
lines.en: The moss shifts a little as it turns over underneath.

lines.zh: 这棵老树的根部住进了一条蛞蝓。
lines.en: A slug has moved in at the roots of this old tree.

lines.zh: 它落地很轻，几乎没声音。
lines.en: It lands very lightly, almost without sound.

lines.zh: 一根触角从叶背探出来，慢慢升高。
lines.en: A tentacle shows from under the leaf and rises slowly.

lines.zh: 潮湿的木头里，有什么在慢慢挪动。
lines.en: Something is shifting slowly inside the damp wood.

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓游动
lines.en: Banana slug moves!

lines.zh: 黏液中孵化
lines.en: Spawn from goo!

lines.zh: 黏液里爬出
lines.en: Goo crawl!

lines.zh: 黏液下诞生
lines.en: Goo birth!

lines.zh: 黏液中诞生
lines.en: Goo spawn!

lines.zh: 黏液中孵化出
lines.en: Spawn from goo!

lines.zh: 香蕉蛞蝓游出
lines.en: Banana slug spawns!

lines.zh: 黏液中游动
lines.en: Goo slither!

lines.zh: 黏液里爬行
lines.en: Goo crawl!

lines.zh: 黏液中蠕动
lines.en: Goo wriggle!

lines.zh: 它的黏液被烤得吱吱响。
lines.en: Its slime sizzles under the heat.

lines.zh: 我的黏液被烤得吱吱响。
lines.en: My slime sizzles in the heat.

lines.zh: 从方块上掉下来，它软软地弹了一下。
lines.en: It falls from the block and bounces softly once.

lines.zh: 黏液先落地，我还是摔扁了。
lines.en: My slime lands first, but I still flatten.

lines.zh: 它在水里缩成一小团，慢慢往下沉。
lines.en: It curls into a small lump and sinks slowly.

lines.zh: 被黏液淹没了。
lines.en: I drowned in slime.

lines.zh: 气浪把它掀到半空，像片湿叶。
lines.en: The blast throws it up like a wet leaf.

lines.zh: 黏液在地上拖出长长的尾。
lines.en: My slime trails out behind me.

lines.zh: 箭扎进去又滑出来，没处着力。
lines.en: The arrow sinks in and slides out, finding no purchase.

lines.zh: 我中了箭。
lines.en: I was hit by an arrow.

lines.zh: 它缩了一下，不知道痛从哪儿来。
lines.en: It flinches without knowing where the pain came from.

lines.zh: 黏液被法术烧得吱吱响。
lines.en: Magic sizzled my slime trail.

lines.zh: 找不到真菌，它开始啃树皮。
lines.en: Finding no fungus, it starts gnawing at bark.

lines.zh: 饿得不行了。
lines.en: Starvation hurts.

lines.zh: 雷打过，它周围的黏液焦成黑边。
lines.en: After the strike, the slime around it is scorched black.

lines.zh: 雷击伤了我的身体。
lines.en: Lightning struck me.

lines.zh: 它伸出触角，在空处慢慢摸索。
lines.en: It reaches out a tentacle and gropes at nothing.

lines.zh: 我在虚空中消失了。
lines.en: I vanished in the void.
